key_reasoning.reason: Touches the shared file_processor_pool helper (in-worker inline execution, bounded waits), FilesDatasourceLoader (timed-out files counted as failed), SharePoint loader routing, new exception types, datasource config, and the docx/file_analysis tool layer that must not relabel the timeout error.

Process-pool deadlock fix with worker-detection flag, timeout semantics across process boundaries (exception pickling via __reduce__), pool reinitialisation and start-method behaviour. Concurrency-sensitive, with a real-process test needed. Closest pattern is the existing maybe_pool_submit helper, which did not cover nested submits.
22 files per diffstat (about 10 source, 12 test including a new pool_worker_helpers module and a real-process test), which maps to XXL by file count even though roughly half of the files are tests.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: concurrency and timeout handling in a shared process pool (performance and scalability concern)
Component Scope held at L: touches a core shared utility (file_processor_pool) used by multiple loaders and tools
